item.text: The traversal currently uses OS calls for stat/open, symlink checks, ignore markers, and readability. I’m tracing the scanner’s entry point and `IsDirReadable` call sites next so the API change remains consistent all the way from configured media folders.

The scanner currently has only a path string, so I’ll create `os.DirFS(rootFolder)` at the entry point and use slash-separated paths relative to that FS internally; emitted paths remain filesystem paths for the database. `fs.Stat`, `fs.ReadDir`, and `fs.Open` will replace OS calls, including symlink resolution where the FS supports it. I’ll also remove the now unused utility.
